public_transcript_analysis_command: python3 -m bench_bench analyze-runs --input-dir runs/public-leaderboard --json reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.json --markdown reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.md
public_transcript_note: No public transcripts are present before independent review. After the live run, analyze-runs or render-replay applies to runner transcripts; the replay command applies to native play episode logs.
multi_model_command: python3 -m bench_bench run-model-suite --base-url https://api.openai.com/v1 --models gpt-5.4,gpt-5.4-mini,gpt-5.3-chat-latest,gpt-4.1 --weeks 52 --seed-values 100,101,102,103,104,105,106,107,108,109 --temperature 0.2 --max-retries 1 --request-retries 8 --retry-backoff-seconds 5 --output-dir runs/public-leaderboard --analysis-json reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.json --analysis-markdown reports/PUBLIC_LEADERBOARD.md
public_leaderboard_note: The authoritative leaderboard is intentionally pending the frozen-protocol live run on public seeds 100–109; no model calls have been made for this release candidate.
